water.","source_id":"26c06a25-ce49-4bb7-97c4-372b399d48f5","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Now look at that harbor.","source_id":"0668a55e-046a-4290-b3d3-474238394414","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"It's the reason this whole city got built.","source_id":"0668a55e-046a-4290-b3d3-474238394414","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Back in 1609, Henry Hudson and a crew of sixteen sailed up this river, certain they'd find Asia waiting at its mouth.","source_id":"0668a55e-046a-4290-b3d3-474238394414","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"They were wrong about Asia, but Hudson's reports on the great harbor and the money to be made in animal pelts pulled the Dutch across the Atlantic to settle.","source_id":"0668a55e-046a-4290-b3d3-474238394414","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"They guessed, rightly, that this harbor would be the hinge connecting Europe to the whole rich interior of the continent, by way of the river.","source_id":"0668a55e-046a-4290-b3d3-474238394414","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"And once the Erie Canal linked the Hudson to the Great Lakes, New York became the most powerful city in the nation.","source_id":"0668a55e-046a-4290-b3d3-474238394414","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Those first Dutch settlers landed right here in 1625, and to guard the pocket of land they called New Amsterdam they lined a battery of cannon along the shore.","source_id":"369b0c7b-bf62-4874-8263-badd86e94a7f","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0,"also_cites":["b182930e-d035-4206-85c4-54ef7f01d283"]},{"text":"That row of guns is exactly where the park gets its name.","source_id":"369b0c7b-bf62-4874-8263-badd86e94a7f","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"There's a round stone fort in the park called Castle Clinton, thrown up to hold off a British invasion in 1812.","source_id":"3db85395-f2a6-46d1-b0ab-239bfc3188c9","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"After the war it found a second life as an immigration station, taking in newcomers before Ellis Island ever opened, and today it holds displays of historic Manhattan.","source_id":"3db85395-f2a6-46d1-b0ab-239bfc3188c9","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"It's also where you buy your ferry ticket out to the Statue of Liberty and Ellis Island.","source_id":"3db85395-f2a6-46d1-b0ab-239bfc3188c9","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"These twenty-five acres are downtown's largest public space, laid out with gardens, sculptures, and winding walkways.","source_id":"369b0c7b-bf62-4874-8263-badd86e94a7f","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0,"also_cites":["b182930e-d035-4206-85c4-54ef7f01d283"]},{"text":"One memorial remembers the dead of the Korean War; another honors the Italian navigator Giovanni da Verrazzano.","source_id":"b182930e-d035-4206-85c4-54ef7f01d283","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"Look out and the Statue of Liberty stands across the harbor, with tugboats and barges working the water past her.","source_id":"369b0c7b-bf62-4874-8263-badd86e94a7f","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"And if it all looks familiar, this is where Madonna worked her magic in the 1985 film Desperately Seeking Susan.","source_id":"b17a87d3-996f-4f0f-b103-b580caca6f72","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":0},{"text":"That's Battery Park — where a harbor made a
